title: Client Discovery Harness - Key Issue
description: A decision the evidence has brought into focus. Its own record rather than a field on a SWOT card, because a real issue usually arises from several SWOT items at once and Phase 4 needs a stable thing to reference. swot_issue_ids has minItems 1: the chain Evidence -> Finding -> SWOT -> Key Issue has no shortcut at any link.

statement.description: The decision question, e.g. which market to pursue first, or whether the competitive advantage matches what buyers actually decide on.

decision_area.description: Short slug for what this bears on, e.g. market_priority, buyer_selection, competitive_position, pricing_fit, evidence_gap.

swot_issue_ids.description: The SWOT items this issue arises from. Must not be empty.

strategic_implication.description: Required. Decision support, not a decision: what the current evidence favours, what is still unverified, and what to check next. A candidate without a usable one is rejected outright rather than stored with the field blanked, so every record here satisfies this schema completely.
